title: rosa canina var. pouzinii
intro: Rosa canina var. pouzinii, commonly known as the Alpenrose or Alpine Rose, is a variety of the Rosa canina species, a flowering shrub native to the European Alps. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Rosa canina var. pouzinii are attributed to its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and vasoprotective agent, which can help to protect the blood vessels and improve circulation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
